design_items.evidence_zh: 提出了完整的对径式AI创新带总体概念、命名体系、三大定位五大功能、一径三核双环多庭空间结构、区域创新协同关系
design_items.evidence_en: Proposed complete Diameter AI Innovation Belt overall concept, naming system, three positionings and five functions, one-diameter-three-cores-two-rings-multi-courtyards spatial structure, and regional innovation synergy relationship
design_items.notes_zh: 视觉识别和Logo方向为概念性指引，需由专业品牌设计团队深化

design_items.evidence_zh: 明确了一径三核双环多庭的空间结构和功能布局，完成概念性总平面图框架；但因边界为provisional，暂不具备精确用地布局深度
design_items.evidence_en: Clarified the spatial structure and functional layout of one diameter, three cores, two rings, and multiple courtyards; completed conceptual master plan framework; but due to provisional boundary, precise land use layout depth not yet available
design_items.notes_zh: 待精确边界公布后深化至方案设计深度

design_items.evidence_zh: 构建了全链条创新生态体系（基础研究-技术研发-成果转化-产业集聚-场景应用），提出多层次加速体系、产学研空间融合模式、八要素保障机制
design_items.evidence_en: Constructed full-chain innovation ecosystem (basic research - technology R&D - achievement transformation - industry agglomeration - scenario application), proposed multi-level acceleration system, industry-university-research spatial integration model, and eight-element guarantee mechanism

design_items.evidence_zh: 提出了智慧交通、智慧能源、智慧环境、智慧社区、智慧园区等场景方向和东翼场景赋能翼空间布局；但10张AI场景卡、3个产业测试验证场景、5类用户画像需在后续迭代中补充
design_items.evidence_en: Proposed smart transportation, smart energy, smart environment, smart community, smart park and other scenario directions and east wing scenario empowerment wing spatial layout; but 10 AI scenario cards, 3 industry test verification scenarios, and 5 user personas need to be supplemented in subsequent iterations
design_items.notes_zh: v1.0版本为场景框架，v1.1迭代补充完整场景卡和用户画像

design_items.evidence_zh: 完成了9公里对径公共空间的断面设计、步行舒适度设计、自行车道系统设计、人性化设施配置；提出三级创新节点体系和创新交往脊柱设计
design_items.evidence_en: Completed cross-section design of 9km diameter public space, walkability comfort design, bicycle lane system design, and humanized facility configuration; proposed three-level innovation node system and innovation interaction spine design

design_items.evidence_zh: 提出了AI原点大厦、京张铁路纪念馆、AI原点科技馆等3个以上地标的功能定位和概念形象；建筑形态和具体设计有待深化
design_items.evidence_en: Proposed functional positioning and conceptual images of 3+ landmarks including AI Origin Tower, Jing-Zhang Railway Memorial Hall, and AI Origin Science & Technology Museum; architectural form and specific design need deepening
design_items.notes_zh: 地标建筑为概念性示意，需由专业建筑设计团队深化

design_items.evidence_zh: 提出了轨道主导、慢行优先、智慧赋能的绿色交通体系框架；包含轨道交通TOD、分级路网、慢行系统三道一绿、智能交通等方向，但未达到工程方案深度
design_items.evidence_en: Proposed green transportation system framework of transit-oriented, pedestrian/bicycle-priority, smart-empowered; includes rail TOD, hierarchical road network, three-lane-one-green slow traffic system, smart transportation directions, but not reaching engineering plan depth
design_items.notes_zh: 道路交通为概念性策略，需由专业交通团队进行深化设计

design_items.evidence_zh: 构建了一脊三廊多点生态格局，提出建筑低碳、交通低碳、能源低碳、碳汇提升四路径，海绵城市和韧性安全体系框架完整
design_items.evidence_en: Constructed one-ridge-three-corridors-multiple-points ecological pattern, proposed four paths of building low-carbon, transportation low-carbon, energy low-carbon, and carbon sink enhancement; complete sponge city and resilient safety system framework

design_items.evidence_zh: 系统梳理三条文化脉络（京张铁路/中关村/AI），提出中国创新时间轴线性叙事方法、文化设施布局体系、品牌节庆活动体系、视觉形象标识系统方向
design_items.evidence_en: Systematically organized three cultural veins (Jing-Zhang Railway / Zhongguancun / AI), proposed China Innovation Timeline linear narrative method, cultural facility layout system, brand festival activity system, and visual identity system direction

design_items.evidence_zh: 构建了多层次人才住房体系（5类住房产品+比例分配）、15分钟优质生活圈（基础保障+品质提升+创新特色三级配置）、四位一体创新生活共同体模式
design_items.evidence_en: Constructed multi-level talent housing system (5 types of housing products + proportion allocation), 15-minute quality living circle (basic guarantee + quality improvement + innovation feature three-level configuration), four-in-one innovation living community model

design_items.evidence_zh: 提出了算力、网络、感知、能源四类新型基础设施的规划方向和总体框架；市政基础设施（水、废、能）给出目标和策略导向
design_items.evidence_en: Proposed planning directions and overall framework for four types of new infrastructure: computing, network, sensing, and energy; municipal infrastructure (water, waste, energy) provides targets and strategic guidance
design_items.notes_zh: 基础设施为概念性规划，需由专业市政团队深化

design_items.evidence_zh: 提出三期实施阶段划分（启动期/加速期/成熟期）、十大标杆项目、BID模式本土化治理架构、三元协同运营模式、多元化投融资模式、空间供给创新路径
design_items.evidence_en: Proposed three-phase implementation stages (start-up / acceleration / maturity), ten benchmark projects, BID-model localized governance structure, ternary collaborative operation model, diversified investment and financing models, and spatial supply innovation paths

design_items.evidence_zh: 使用provisional边界生成概念性空间数据，包括场地边界、重点区域、用地布局、建筑基底、道路中心线、绿地、公共空间、分期等图层
design_items.evidence_en: Generate conceptual spatial data using provisional boundary, including site boundary, key areas, land use layout, building footprint, road centerline, green space, public space, phasing and other layers
design_items.notes_zh: 空间数据为provisional状态，精确边界发布后需重新生成并校验

design_items.evidence_zh: 包含总体结构图、空间总平面图、用地规划图、交通系统图、绿地系统图、公共空间系统图、文化轴示意图、实施分期图等图纸目录
design_items.evidence_en: Includes drawing catalog of overall structure diagram, spatial master plan, land use plan, transportation system diagram, green space system diagram, public space system diagram, cultural axis schematic diagram, implementation phasing diagram
design_items.notes_zh: 图纸为概念性示意图，待空间数据完善后更新精细图纸

design_items.evidence_zh: 规划HTML交互网页包含方案展示、空间可视化、指标分析等功能模块
design_items.evidence_en: Planned HTML interactive webpage includes proposal presentation, spatial visualization, indicator analysis and other functional modules
design_items.notes_zh: HTML可视化成果计划在v1.1版本中完成
